---
title: "ARCHY560 Week 2: Lithic Data Cleaning"
format: docx

---

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

# read in the data
lithic_data <- read_csv("lithics_raw.csv")

# clean the data
lithic_data_clean <- 
lithic_data |> # pipe 'then', cmd, shift, m
  mutate(length_mm = parse_number(length_mm)) |>
  mutate(platform_mm = parse_number(platform_mm)) |>
  drop_na(length_mm, platform_mm) # drop rows where the cleaned values are missing



```
